messages.subject.a2CropCoherence: Consistency between declared crop and observed profile
messages.subject.b3SoilCover: Minimum soil cover during the sensitive period
messages.subject.b6PermanentGrassland: Environmentally sensitive permanent grassland: no conversion
messages.subject.c3CatchCrops: Catch crops between two main crops
messages.subject.d1MowingGrazing: Mowing and grazing on permanent grassland
messages.method.a1AgriculturalActivity: Management EVENTS are sought (sharp NDVI drops), not the greenness level: abandoned land invaded by scrub has a high, stable NDVI — higher than freshly ploughed arable land.
messages.method.a2CropCoherence: The crop is NOT classified: the observed profile is compared with the NDVI band expected for the declared crop. A divergence is a hint to look into, not an alternative crop.
messages.method.a3DeclaredArea: Two comparisons kept apart: the geometric one (declared area against the polygon's geodesic area), which is exact, and the vegetated one, indicative because edge pixels are mixed.
messages.method.b1BufferStrips: A GEOMETRIC, not spectral check: minimum distance between the plot and the loaded hydrographic network. A three-metre strip is a third of a pixel — looking for it in NDVI would be make-believe.
messages.method.b3SoilCover: Share of DAYS (not scenes) above threshold in the sensitive window, by linear interpolation. NDVI cannot tell a sown cover crop from spontaneous weeds.
messages.method.b4CropRotation: First the declared campaigns of previous years, which are unambiguous; then, as corroboration, the similarity between monthly NDVI profiles.
messages.method.b5NonProductiveAreas: No processing: hedges, isolated trees and field margins are below the 10 m pixel. Orthophotos or very-high-resolution imagery are needed — and that is what this card says.
messages.method.b6PermanentGrassland: Deep drops WITHOUT regrowth ending on bare soil: the signature of ploughing, not mowing. Regrowth is what tells this card apart from D1.
messages.method.b7WetlandsPeatlands: Intersection with the designated wetland layer, then a persistent drop in the moisture index. A dry year produces the same drop as drainage.
messages.method.b8StubbleBurning: NBR collapse in the post-harvest window: char absorbs in the NIR and reflects in SWIR2. It requires band B12, which no other index in the product uses.
messages.method.c1OrchardGroundCover: Green cover in the required window. In a narrow-spaced vineyard a 10 m pixel contains rows and inter-rows together: the value is an average and cannot be separated.
messages.method.c2ExtensiveForage: A profile consistent with forage (prolonged cover, several cuts) and no plant-protection treatments in the year, read from the logbook and not from the satellite.
messages.method.c3CatchCrops: Persistence of cover between two main crops. A sowing recorded in the logbook shows the cover was intended: without it, NDVI cannot tell it from weeds.
messages.method.d1MowingGrazing: NDVI drops followed by REGROWTH: regrowth is what tells mowing from a land-use change. Extensive grazing may produce no clear step at all.
messages.method.d2SowingHarvestDates: Phenological signature against recorded dates. The satellite sees emergence, not sowing: days or weeks separate them, which is why tolerance starts at three weeks.
messages.method.d4Irrigation: SAR (Sentinel-1) or thermal (Landsat TIRS, ECOSTRESS) would be needed: multispectral optical imagery cannot see applied water. The card reports what the logbook declares.
messages.method.organicInputs: Not satellite-based: the logbook and the batches actually issued from the store are read and compared with a dated version of the annexes to EU Reg. 2021/1165.
messages.explain.a1Active: {{events}} management events observed in the year; the last around {{lastEvent}}.
messages.explain.a1Marginal: {{events}} management events observed out of {{minEvents}} expected; the profile does vary (amplitude {{amplitude}}), so an event may have fallen into an observation gap.
messages.explain.a1Abandoned: No management events and vegetation present on {{activeSharePct}}% of days with a flat profile (amplitude {{amplitude}}): the typical signature of land no longer worked.
messages.explain.a2Coherent: Observed maximum {{observedMax}}, consistent with the {{expectedLow}}–{{expectedHigh}} band expected for “{{crop}}” (tolerance {{tolerance}}).
messages.explain.a2Divergent: Observed maximum {{observedMax}} against the {{expectedLow}}–{{expectedHigh}} band expected for “{{crop}}”: worth a look. No alternative crop is proposed, as none could be named reliably.
messages.explain.a3Consistent: {{declared}} ha declared against {{geometric}} ha geometric ({{deltaPct}}%, tolerance {{tolerancePct}}%); vegetated for {{vegetatedSharePct}}% of the period.
messages.explain.a3Overdeclared: {{declared}} ha declared against {{geometric}} ha geometric: {{deltaPct}}% beyond the {{tolerancePct}}% tolerance. The comparison is exact, not estimated.
messages.explain.a3VegetatedShortfall: Declared area consistent, but vegetation present only {{vegetatedSharePct}}% of the period. Indicative estimate: {{purePixels}} pure pixels.
messages.explain.b1Compliant: Minimum distance to the water network {{distance}} m, beyond the required {{width}} m strip.
messages.explain.b1TooClose: Minimum distance to the water network {{distance}} m, below the required {{width}} m strip. The result is only as good as the loaded hydrographic layer.
messages.explain.b3Covered: Soil covered on {{sharePct}}% of the days in the sensitive window (required {{requiredPct}}%, NDVI threshold {{threshold}}).
messages.explain.b3PartiallyCovered: Soil covered on {{sharePct}}% of days, below the required {{requiredPct}}% but not far off: worth checking before next season.
messages.explain.b3Bare: Soil covered only {{sharePct}}% of days against the required {{requiredPct}}%: mostly bare soil during the sensitive period.
messages.explain.b4Rotated: {{distinctCrops}} distinct crops over {{declaredYears}} declared years; profile distance {{distance}} (similarity threshold {{similarityMax}}).
messages.explain.b4Monoculture: A single crop over {{declaredYears}} declared years; nearly identical profiles (distance {{distance}}, threshold {{similarityMax}}): consistent with monocropping.
messages.explain.b6Stable: No drop consistent with conversion; {{mowing}} cuts observed and an NDVI floor of {{floor}} (bare-soil threshold {{bareSoil}}).
messages.explain.b6Converted: {{conversions}} deep drops without regrowth down to bare soil, the first around {{date}}: consistent with ploughing of the grassland.
messages.explain.b7NoSignal: No persistent drop in the moisture index ({{drops}} events detected).
messages.explain.b7DrainageSignal: {{drops}} moisture-index drops beyond the {{threshold}} threshold. A dry year produces the same signal: ground checking is needed.
messages.explain.b8NoBurnSignal: No NBR collapse in the post-harvest window (threshold {{threshold}}).
messages.explain.b8BurnSignal: {{events}} NBR collapses in the post-harvest window, the first around {{date}}. An authorised phytosanitary derogation produces the same signal.
messages.explain.c1Covered: Inter-row covered on {{sharePct}}% of days (required {{requiredPct}}%), with a declared row spacing of {{rowSpacing}} m.
messages.explain.c1Bare: Cover on {{sharePct}}% of days against {{requiredPct}}% required. With {{rowSpacing}} m spacing the pixel mixes row and inter-row: ground checking advised.
messages.explain.c2Compatible: Cover on {{sharePct}}% of days (required {{requiredPct}}%) and no plant-protection treatment recorded in the year.
messages.explain.c2Incompatible: Cover on {{sharePct}}% of days (required {{requiredPct}}%) and {{treatments}} plant-protection treatments recorded in the year.
messages.explain.c3Present: Cover for {{coveredDays}} days (minimum {{minDays}}); sowings recorded in the window: {{sowing}}.
messages.explain.c3Absent: Cover for only {{coveredDays}} days against the {{minDays}} minimum required.
messages.explain.d1NoEvents: {{events}} cuts observed out of {{minEvents}} expected. Extensive grazing lowers biomass gradually and may produce no clear step.
messages.explain.d2Consistent: Harvest recorded on {{declared}}, observed around {{observed}}: {{gapDays}} days apart (tolerance {{tolerance}}).
messages.explain.d2Divergent: Harvest recorded on {{declared}} but observed around {{observed}}: {{gapDays}} days apart, beyond the {{tolerance}} tolerance. The record needs review.
messages.explain.d4NotObservable: Irrigation is not observable with multispectral optical imagery. The logbook declares {{declaredEvents}} irrigations in the year; moisture-index range {{ndmiRange}}.
messages.explain.organicCompliant: {{operations}} inputs checked against the {{act}} annexes (version {{version}}): no non-permitted substance. Copper {{copper}}/{{copperLimit}} kg/ha, nitrogen {{nitrogen}}/{{nitrogenLimit}} kg N/ha.
messages.explain.organicAttention: {{unknown}} substances not listed in {{act}} (version {{version}}), or data insufficient for a limit. Copper {{copper}}/{{copperLimit}} kg/ha, nitrogen {{nitrogen}}/{{nitrogenLimit}} kg N/ha.
messages.explain.organicNonCompliant: {{notAllowed}} inputs with substances not permitted by the {{act}} annexes (version {{version}}), or a limit exceeded. Copper {{copper}}/{{copperLimit}} kg/ha, nitrogen {{nitrogen}}/{{nitrogenLimit}} kg N/ha.
messages.explain.undecidable: There is no basis for a decision: the method was not run. What is missing, and how to complete it, is listed below.

messages.factor.cloudCover: mean cloud cover {{meanCloudPct}}% on the scenes used

messages.missing.noUsableScenes: Not enough usable scenes: {{usable}} of {{required}} needed
messages.missing.noUsableScenesFix: Wait for further satellite passes, or raise the accepted cloud-cover threshold in the parameters
messages.missing.tooFewPurePixels: Plot too small for the sensor: {{purePixels}} estimated pure pixels against {{minPurePixels}} needed
messages.missing.tooFewPurePixelsFix: Waiting will not help: at 10 m resolution edge pixels dominate the signal. Orthophotos or very-high-resolution imagery are needed
messages.missing.archiveTooShort: Archive too short: {{available}} years available out of {{required}} required
messages.missing.archiveTooShortFix: Run the historical scene retrieval ({{required}} years): the local cache holds 24 months, the rest must be downloaded
messages.missing.indexNotInPipeline: Index {{index}} is not present in the cached scenes
messages.missing.indexNotInPipelineFix: Reprocess the scenes including {{index}}: it needs a band the pipeline does not download by default, adding traffic per scene
messages.missing.campaign: No agricultural campaign declared for this year
messages.missing.campaignFix: Fill in the plot's crop sheet for the year
messages.missing.cropFix: Enter the species and crop code in the crop sheet
messages.missing.declaredAreaFix: Enter the declared area in the crop sheet
messages.missing.operations: No operation recorded in the logbook for this plot
messages.missing.operationsFix: Record the operations in the field logbook
messages.missing.productionRegime: Production regime not declared for this year
messages.missing.productionRegimeFix: Choose the regime in the crop sheet (conventional, in conversion, organic, integrated)
messages.missing.issues: No warehouse batch linked to the operations
messages.missing.issuesFix: Link issued batches to the operations: those are the real quantities, not the planned ones
messages.missing.terrainFix: Load a digital terrain model for the area
messages.missing.layerFix: Load the map layer and tag it with the “{{layer}}” compliance tag
messages.missing.copperContentFix: Add the metallic-copper percentage to the product metadata: without it, the amount of formulation says nothing about the copper applied
messages.missing.nitrogenContentFix: Fill in the N content in the product registry, or the N-P-K ratio in the operation
messages.missing.regimeSinceFix: Set “under this regime since” in the crop sheet: the 24 or 36 conversion months are counted from there
messages.missing.resolutionTooCoarse: Feature about {{featureWidth}} m below the sensor's {{gsd}} m resolution
messages.missing.resolutionTooCoarseFix: Orthophotos (20–50 cm) or VHR imagery are needed: with Sentinel-2 this check cannot be anticipated — which is itself useful to know
messages.missing.sensorNotAvailable: Suitable sensor not available in the pipeline
messages.missing.sensorNotAvailableFix: SAR (Sentinel-1) or thermal (Landsat TIRS, ECOSTRESS) would be needed: multispectral optical imagery cannot see applied water
messages.parameter.activityNdviThreshold: NDVI threshold above which the area counts as vegetated

messages.parameter.coverMinDaysShare: Minimum share of covered days in the window (0–1)

messages.parameter.cloudCoverMax: Maximum cloud cover for a scene to be usable
messages.parameter.areaTolerancePct: Tolerance on the gap between declared and geometric area
messages.parameter.mowingDropDelta: Minimum NDVI drop to recognise an event
messages.parameter.mowingMinEvents: Minimum cuts required in the year
messages.parameter.mowingRecoveryDays: Days within which the sward must regrow for the drop to be a cut
messages.parameter.slopeThresholdDeg: Slope beyond which the obligation applies
messages.parameter.rotationSimilarityMax: Distance below which two annual profiles count as the same crop
messages.parameter.grasslandConversionDrop: NDVI drop consistent with grassland conversion
messages.parameter.catchCropMinDays: Minimum days the catch crop must stay in the field
messages.parameter.phenologyToleranceDays: Tolerated gap between recorded and observed date
messages.parameter.copperLimitKgHa: Metallic-copper limit over the rolling window
messages.parameter.copperWindowYears: Length in years of the rolling copper window
messages.parameter.coherenceTolerance: Tolerated deviation from the NDVI band expected for the crop
messages.parameter.vegetatedNdviThreshold: NDVI threshold above which a pixel counts as vegetated
messages.parameter.featureWidthM: Typical width of the non-productive feature observed
messages.parameter.nonProductiveSharePct: Minimum share of non-productive area required
messages.parameter.bareSoilNdvi: NDVI threshold below which soil counts as bare
messages.parameter.rowSpacingM: Row spacing: distance between rows, which sets the inter-row width
messages.parameter.forageCoverThreshold: NDVI cover threshold for the forage system
messages.parameter.forageMinCoverShare: Minimum share of covered days in the forage system
messages.parameter.catchCropNdviThreshold: NDVI threshold for the catch crop
messages.organic.substanceUnknown: “{{substance}}” is not in the reference list: check it against {{act}}. The list is deliberately partial, so absence does not mean prohibition
messages.organic.copperWithinLimit: Copper {{value}} kg/ha of the {{limit}} permitted over {{years}} years
messages.organic.copperNearLimit: Copper {{value}} kg/ha close to the {{limit}} limit over {{years}} years
messages.organic.copperOverLimit: Copper {{value}} kg/ha beyond the {{limit}} limit over {{years}} years
messages.organic.copperUndecidable: Copper cannot be computed: {{uncountable}} operations lack the copper content in the {{years}}-year window
messages.organic.nitrogenWithinLimit: Organic nitrogen {{value}} kg N/ha of the {{limit}} permitted ({{counted}} applications counted)
messages.organic.nitrogenOverLimit: Organic nitrogen {{value}} kg N/ha beyond the {{limit}} limit
messages.organic.nitrogenUndecidable: Nitrogen cannot be computed: {{uncountable}} applications lack the nitrogen content
messages.organic.conversionOngoing: Conversion under way: it ends on {{endsOn}} ({{months}} months)
messages.organic.conversionUnknown: Conversion period cannot be computed: the regime start date is missing
messages.organic.incompleteOperations: Incomplete operation: not enough data to conclude
messages.subject.b2SlopeScope: GAEC 5 scope: is the plot on a slope?
messages.method.b2SlopeScope: Mean and maximum slope from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Horn's algorithm), compared with the regional threshold. Tillage is not detected: furrow direction, which is what the rule governs, is not observable at 10 m.
messages.explain.b2NotInScope: Mean slope {{slope}}° (max {{maxSlope}}°), below the {{threshold}}° threshold: the plot falls outside the GAEC 5 obligation. Source: {{source}}.
messages.explain.b2InScope: Mean slope {{slope}}° (max {{maxSlope}}°), above the {{threshold}}° threshold: the plot falls under GAEC 5. Check the regional tillage rules. Source: {{source}}.
messages.explain.b5NeedsOrthophoto: An orthophoto is needed: at 10 m a {{featureWidth}} m wide feature cannot be resolved. At least {{requiredGsdCm}} cm resolution is required.
messages.explain.b5OrthophotoTooCoarse: Orthophoto at {{gsdCm}} cm: too coarse for a {{featureWidth}} m wide feature, which needs at least {{requiredGsdCm}} cm.
messages.explain.b5OrthophotoNoBands: Orthophoto {{fileName}} has {{bandCount}} bands: estimating green cover needs at least 3 (R, G, B). It remains usable for visual checking.
messages.explain.b5Sufficient: {{sharePct}}% of the area reads as vegetated over {{pixels}} pixels at {{gsdCm}} cm ({{fileName}}), above the required {{requiredShare}}%. Indicative RGB classification: it does not tell a hedge from a weed.
messages.explain.b5Insufficient: {{sharePct}}% of the area reads as vegetated over {{pixels}} pixels at {{gsdCm}} cm ({{fileName}}), below the required {{requiredShare}}%. The estimate is RGB and indicative: check visually before drawing conclusions.
messages.missing.orthophoto: High-resolution orthophoto for a {{featureWidth}} m wide feature
messages.missing.orthophotoFix: Upload a georeferenced GeoTIFF with at least {{requiredGsdCm}} cm resolution (national, regional or drone orthophoto).
messages.missing.orthophotoBandsFix: Upload a colour orthophoto (R, G, B): green cover cannot be estimated with fewer than three bands.

disclaimer.full: This is a SELF-ASSESSMENT based on public satellite observations and on your field logbook. It is not an official check: area monitoring (AMS, EU Reg. 2021/2116 art. 66) belongs to the Paying Agency, and organic verification to the control body. Every card states its method, thresholds, scenes used and uncertainty: read them together with the outcome.

import.title: Import products from CSV
import.instructions: Header row required, delimiter ; or , (auto-detected). Required columns: category, name, unit. Optional: registration_number, active_substance, npk_n, npk_p, npk_k, uma_code, supplier, notes, min_stock, safety_period_days, reentry_interval_h, species, scientific_name, variety_name, crop_category, lot_number, expires_at, initial_quantity, unit_cost.
import.categoryRules: category accepts phytosanitary, fertilizer, seed, fuel, other (Italian aliases work too). The form's rules still apply: plant protection products need a registration number, fertilizers N-P-K titres between 0 and 100, fuel a UMA code.
import.lotNotice: The opening stock is optional: with initial_quantity and unit_cost a lot is created and the weighted average cost moves; without them only the product record is imported, at zero stock. Expiry dates go in as YYYY-MM-DD.
import.errorRegistrationRequired: registration number required for plant protection products
